address: 1F, Elegance Court, 2-4 Tsoi Tak Street, Happy Valley, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: This upstairs restaurant is helmed by Chef Li, who started cooking professionally in the UK at the age of 16 and his dishes are rooted in Chinese traditions, but underpinned by modern French techniques and novel food combinations. He has an affinity for perfumed oils and the use of fried tofu and fried pork lard in caramelised sweet and sour Iberico pork is ingenious. His aromatic smoked soy sauce chicken is also unmissable....
